name: Lineup card builds from headliner to full bill
looks: Over the same ribbon ground, a date badge lands first, then a headliner name in the largest size, a second name just beneath it, and finally several rows of smaller names landing together in a dense block, each row shrinking the type scale as it goes further down the hierarchy. The whole card swaps once to a second day with a new headliner.
build: list-stack-reveal driving the top-down build, but each tier also steps down in font size rather than only dimming, so the hierarchy reads in scale as well as order; the full day-to-day swap is a quick crossfade/slide on the whole card, power2.inOut.
sound: A tick per tier landing, faster and lighter for the dense bottom rows, then a whoosh on the day swap.
prompt: Build a lineup or roster card in clear order of importance: a date or category lands first, then the single biggest name at full size, then supporting names at a smaller size, finishing on a dense block of the rest at the smallest size, then swap the whole card once to a second set.
